Dataset Description: 
	

PhysicalAI-WorldModel-Synthetic-Autonomous-Driving-Scenarios is a large-scale synthetic video dataset of autonomous-driving scenes generated with NVIDIA's internal Omniverse simulation platform. Each clip is a temporally consistent multi-camera surround capture of one ego vehicle and surrounding traffic participants, paired with per-camera VLM captions.
